open_findings.finding: Lastenheft/spec said links use nested <Send>/<Receive> elements. Real ETS6 file has ZERO of those; links are a Links="GA-x" attribute (space-separated), with short GA ids resolving to full ids. Send/Receive direction is NOT stored per-link.
open_findings.impact: FR-04 (link with Send/Receive prompt) rests on a wrong data model. Direction comes from the KO flags in the manufacturer app-XML, not from the link.
open_findings.status: RESOLVED — researched KNX docs. Direction is order-based (first linked GA = sending address), capability is from KO flags (TransmitFlag/WriteFlag) in the app-XML ComObject/ComObjectRef. No per-link Send/Receive.

fr04_model.description: Ordered link model per KO (KNX-correct, replaces Send/Receive dialog)
rules: A KO holds an ordered list of linked GA ids
index 0 = sending address; all entries = listening addresses
drag&drop appends a GA (listening); first one becomes sending automatically
"Set Sending" moves a GA to index 0
export serializes as Links="<sending> <listening...>" in order
KO flags (TransmitFlag/WriteFlag) from app-XML validate capability, not direction
fr04_model.source: support.knx.org: Sending Group Address, Flags, Group Object
